cd /app/submission && cat > /workspace/tmp/t3.py << 'PY'
import subprocess, json, sys
def run(obj):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/app/submission/entry.py'],input=json.dumps(obj).encode(),capture_output=True)
    try: return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    except: return {'_raw':p.stdout.decode(),'_err':p.stderr.decode()}
def cfg(**kw):
    base=dict(early=False,overlap="reject",buffer_packets=4,idle_ms=0,
              max_streams_bidi=100,max_streams_uni=100,max_stream_data=65536,
              max_data=1000000000,crypto_limit=65536,sent={"I":[],"H":[],"A":[]})
    base.update(kw); return base
def req(traces): return {"version":1,"traces":traces}
def tr(tid,config,events): return {"id":tid,"config":config,"events":events}
def P(level,pn,frames,auth=True): return {"level":level,"pn":pn,"auth":auth,"frames":frames}
def D(t,bytes,packets): return {"t":t,"op":"datagram","bytes":bytes,"packets":packets}
def setup_A(): return {"t":0,"op":"key","level":"A","action":"install"}
tests={}
# overlap reject conflict
tests['overlap_reject']=req([tr("a",cfg(overlap="reject"),[setup_A(),
  D(1,1200,[P("A",0,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"aa","fin":False}])]),
  D(2,1200,[P("A",1,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"bb","fin":False}])]),
])])
# overlap first keeps earlier
tests['overlap_first']=req([tr("a",cfg(overlap="first"),[setup_A(),
  D(1,1200,[P("A",0,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"aa","fin":False}])]),
  D(2,1200,[P("A",1,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"bb","fin":False}])]),
])])
# crypto rollback: valid CRYPTO then bad ACK frame -> rollback crypto
tests['crypto_rollback']=req([tr("a",cfg(sent={"I":[[0,0]],"H":[],"A":[]}),[
  D(0,1200,[P("I",0,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"aabb"},{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[1,1]]}])]),
])])
# crypto limit exceeded
tests['crypto_limit']=req([tr("a",cfg(crypto_limit=3),[
  D(0,1200,[P("I",0,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"aabbccdd"}])]),
])])
# wrong direction stream
tests['wrong_dir']=req([tr("a",cfg(),[setup_A(),
  D(1,1200,[P("A",0,[{"type":"STREAM","id":1,"offset":0,"data_hex":"aa","fin":False}])]),
])])
# stream limit
tests['stream_limit']=req([tr("a",cfg(max_streams_bidi=1),[
  D(1,1200,[P("I",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),  # dummy
  setup_A(),
  D(2,1200,[P("A",0,[{"type":"STREAM","id":4,"offset":0,"data_hex":"aa","fin":False}])]),
])])
# dup shared Z/A
tests['dup_shared']=req([tr("a",cfg(early=True),[
  D(1,1200,[P("Z",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
  setup_A(),
  D(2,1200,[P("A",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
])])
# max_data across streams
tests['max_data']=req([tr("a",cfg(max_data=5),[
  D(1,1200,[P("I",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
  setup_A(),
  D(2,1200,[P("A",0,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"aabbcc","fin":False}])]),
  D(3,1200,[P("A",1,[{"type":"STREAM","id":4,"offset":0,"data_hex":"ddeeff","fin":False}])]),
])])
# STOP wrong direction
tests['stop_wrong']=req([tr("a",cfg(),[
  D(1,1200,[P("I",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
  setup_A(),
  D(2,1200,[P("A",0,[{"type":"STOP_SENDING","id":1}])]),
])])
# reset then stream respecting final_size; reset lower than highest
tests['reset_then_stream']=req([tr("a",cfg(),[
  D(1,1200,[P("I",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
  setup_A(),
  D(2,1200,[P("A",0,[{"type":"RESET_STREAM","id":0,"final_size":4}])]),
  D(3,1200,[P("A",1,[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"aabbccdd","fin":True}])]),
])])
for name,obj in tests.items():
    print("====",name); print(json.dumps(run(obj)))
